text:
ada-devx: Quick report — hitting a parity drift between REST and the Node SDK on the embeddings batch endpoint. curl to /v1/embeddings?allow_partial=true returns partial vectors for failing items, but the SDK call with { allowPartial: true } returns 400.

kevin-sdks: ugh. can you paste the curl + minimal SDK snippet and SDK version?

ada-devx: SDK v1.8.1. Repro: 
```
# REST
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?allow_partial=true" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"model":"tiny-embed","inputs":["short","very long text that times out","ok"]}'
```
JS SDK: 
```
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.TOKEN });
await c.embeddings.create({ model: 'tiny-embed', inputs: ['short', 'long text', 'ok'], allowPartial: true });
```
REST -> 200 with partials + per-item errors; SDK -> 400 "unknown parameter: allowPartial".

sophie-samples: our quickstart CI started failing on mixed-length batches — blocks onboarding. :grimacing:

maria-api: context: the batch embeddings endpoint historically accepts allow_partial as a query flag (snake_case). The server validator rejects unknown JSON body keys. Looks like the SDK serializer is putting allowPartial into the request body rather than the query string. We currently emit both Retry-After and X-Retry-After-Ms headers for a transition window.

kevin-sdks: two things to fix: 1) param normalization/mapping — accept camelCase aliasing in client and emit allow_partial in query for batch flags; 2) retry precedence — SDK currently reads x-retry-after-ms only which caused aggressive retries in staging. We'll update middleware to prefer standard Retry-After then fall back to the vendor header.

ada-devx: the aggressive retries caused CI to hit repeated 429s and made onboarding noisy.

kevin-sdks: action plan: patch the request serializer to map known flags (allowPartial, partialOK, etc.) to snake_case query params for batch endpoints, add unit tests, and add a small integration smoke test in samples/ci that does a curl vs SDK shape/status diff (only status + top-level keys). Also update retry middleware and add deterministic backoff tests.

ci-bot: New branch opened: fix/sdk-emb-flag-retry-4129 by kevin-sdks — CI started.

sophie-samples: once merged I'll bump the quickstart and rerun CI. Can you also add a CHANGELOG note so customers know v1.8.2 tolerates camelCase flags and respects Retry-After?

kevin-sdks: yes — CHANGELOG entry + short migration note: "Node SDK v1.8.2: tolerate camelCase flags for query options, normalize to server query params for batch endpoints, and prefer standard Retry-After header for backoff."

maria-api: we'll keep emitting both headers during the rollout and add a server-side test to prevent validator regressions.

ada-devx: one more ask — please add the tiny samples smoke test that compares curl vs SDK on embeddings and generate (status + top-level keys only). That would have caught this earlier.

kevin-sdks: +1, adding the smoke test to samples/ci and will coordinate the changelog PR. Rolling a canary post-merge. Thanks all :raised_hands:"
